t2.thesis: ANET enters the print heavily de-risked following a 20% one-month drawdown, positioning its typical beat-and-raise pattern for a relief bounce if AI back-end networking guidance and gross margins meet expectations.
reasons: Steep pre-earnings pullback (-20.7% over 1 month, -24.2% off 52-week highs) lowers the bar for a post-earnings relief reaction.
Consistent fundamental execution and EPS upward revisions (+17.7% over 90 days) demonstrate resilient demand for 800G/1.6T AI Ethernet switching.
Gross margin compression risks and hyperscaler capex concentration moderate upside, aligning historical print wins to a coin-flip 50% over the last 4 quarters.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and non-GAAP gross margin trajectory amid high hyperscaler concentration.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered by 0.036 from cluster prior of 0.586 to 0.55 due to mixed historical 4-quarter print reactions (50%) and headline scrutiny on gross margin sustainability and broad tech momentum.

theses.expected: Q3 beat on revenue and EPS ($1.10+ vs $1.08 est) with Q4 revenue guided above $3.45B
theses.mechanism: Hyperscaler Ethernet back-end deployments accelerate, confirming market share gains against proprietary InfiniBand fabrics.
theses.wrong_if: Supply chain bottlenecks or pricing pressure from top cloud titans compress non-GAAP gross margins below 62%.

theses.mechanism: Management highlights enterprise spending pauses or lumpy hyperscaler shipment schedules, validating recent multi-week tech selloff.
